description: Discovery-phase backend readiness model. For a target backend, lists what the port actually needs, how to probe it on the host, the fallback when it is absent, and the impact x likelihood weight used for the Pareto ranking. Values are requirements of the backend, not claims about a specific machine: the probe decides PASS/FAIL, and an unprobed row is UNVALIDATED, never assumed.

scoring.impact: 1-5. How much a miss hurts: 5 = port cannot ship, 1 = cosmetic.
scoring.likelihood: 0-1. How often this bites on a real port of this kind.
scoring.score: impact * likelihood. Pareto ranks by score; the vital few are the rows that reach 80% of the total.

evidence_labels.FAIL: probed and absent; use the fallback or stop
evidence_labels.NOT RUN: requires a build or a manual step
evidence_labels.UNVALIDATED: could not be probed; treat as absent until proven

rebar.benefit: host-mapped weight and KV streaming without a staging copy; one less full-size buffer per tensor
rebar.fallback: page-locked staging ring + chunked hipMemcpyAsync, double-buffered; keep hot tensors resident in device memory

requirements.need: hipcc that accepts the target gfx
requirements.fallback: build the hsaco on a Linux ROCm host and ship the code object; never hand-encode ISA

requirements.need: agent enumeration to confirm the target gfx is present
requirements.fallback: read the PCI id and map it to gfx manually, then record it

requirements.need: disassemble the produced hsaco to verify what was emitted
requirements.fallback: use llvm-objdump from the LLVM install; a build that cannot be inspected is not verified

requirements.need: 4-way int8 dot for quantised kernels
requirements.fallback: raw v_dot4_i32_i8 may have no gfx12 encoding; use amd_mixed_dot, else scalar expand

requirements.need: a matrix path (MFMA on CDNA, WMMA on RDNA3+)
requirements.fallback: DP4a or scalar FMA reconstruction; a matrix kernel restructured is a design change, not a flag

requirements.need: wave size known before touching shuffle/lane logic
requirements.fallback: rewrite warp intrinsics for the target width; do not pass a wave-size flag and assume it applied

requirements.need: fine-grained host-visible allocation behaviour confirmed
requirements.probe: run one host-mapped copy on target
requirements.fallback: fall back to coarse-grained + explicit copies; record which path ran

requirements.need: code object inspected: SIMD width, VGPRs, spills, LDS, exported symbols
requirements.fallback: a module that compiles but lacks the called symbol is a failure; check the symbol inventory

requirements.need: a working ROCm/HIP stack on the chosen host OS
requirements.fallback: build on Linux and ship the code object, or use the Windows ROCm build that is actually installed

rebar.benefit: larger mapped window for zero-copy weight streaming
rebar.fallback: pinned staging buffers + chunked cudaMemcpyAsync, hot tensors resident

requirements.need: nvcc for the target compute capability
requirements.fallback: match the toolkit to the driver; a newer toolkit than the driver supports produces a load failure, not a compile error

requirements.need: inspect the cubin the build produced
requirements.fallback: nvdisasm on the extracted cubin

requirements.need: tensor cores for an mma.sync port
requirements.fallback: fp32 FMA path; keep it selectable, not a silent downgrade

requirements.need: graph capture behaviour confirmed on this driver
requirements.fallback: rebuild with events; a failed capture must re-run the work, not drop it

requirements.need: managed-memory oversubscription behaviour measured
requirements.fallback: explicit device/host copies with a residency plan

requirements.need: cubin inspected: registers, spills, shared memory, symbols
requirements.fallback: assert the exported kernel list before trusting a successful build

rebar.benefit: host-visible device-local staging for large tensors without a copy
rebar.fallback: host-visible staging buffer + device-local copy, one chunk in flight per queue slot

requirements.need: GLSL to SPIR-V compiler
requirements.fallback: glslangValidator; both must target the same SPIR-V version the driver accepts

requirements.need: a working Vulkan loader and driver
requirements.fallback: install the ICD for the target vendor; a missing ICD looks like an unsupported feature

requirements.need: validate the produced SPIR-V before shipping it
requirements.fallback: let the driver report; a driver error names no line, so keep the module small

requirements.need: cooperative matrix support confirmed on the target driver
requirements.fallback: DP4a via GL_KHR_shader_integer_dot_product; CooperativeMatrix is broken on AMD Vulkan

requirements.need: subgroup size and ops known before porting shuffles
requirements.fallback: workgroup shared-memory reduction instead of subgroup ops

requirements.need: timeline semaphore / fence model mapped to the source stream model
requirements.fallback: single queue with explicit barriers; slower but ordered

requirements.need: SPIR-V module validated and disassembled
requirements.fallback: treat an unvalidated module as unverified

rebar.api: D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_GPU_UPLOAD / custom heap with CPU-visible VRAM (Agility SDK), DXGI budget query
rebar.benefit: CPU-writable VRAM for large weight uploads without a staging copy
rebar.fallback: D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_UPLOAD staging + CopyBufferRegion into DEFAULT heap, chunked per fence value

requirements.need: DXC to compile HLSL to DXIL
requirements.fallback: fxc only reaches SM 5.1; compute shader model 6.x needs DXC

requirements.need: Agility SDK headers for enhanced barriers and GPU upload heaps
requirements.probe: vcpkg list | findstr directxheaders  (or check the NuGet/Agility SDK package)
requirements.fallback: target the OS inbox D3D12 version and drop the newer features explicitly

requirements.need: Windows host (D3D12 is Windows-only)
requirements.fallback: use Vulkan on non-Windows; do not emulate D3D12

requirements.need: enhanced barrier support queried, not assumed
requirements.fallback: legacy resource-state transitions; correct but more transitions

requirements.need: DXGI memory budget queried before sizing the working set
requirements.fallback: size from the modelled budget and stream the remainder

requirements.need: DXIL container inspected for the target shader model
requirements.fallback: unvalidated DXIL is unverified; check the shader model in the container

rebar.api: USM host allocations mapped into the device address space
rebar.benefit: fewer explicit copies when the BAR window covers the working set
rebar.fallback: USM device allocation + explicit memcpy, or buffer/accessor with a copy plan

requirements.need: icpx/dpcpp with the SYCL front end
requirements.fallback: the oneAPI DPC++ compiler is the same front end; a plain clang without SYCL will not compile the code

requirements.need: enumerate devices and confirm the target is visible to SYCL
requirements.fallback: query through the runtime API once and record the device string

requirements.need: USM support confirmed, since the port may rely on shared pointers
requirements.fallback: buffer/accessor model; semantics differ, so test the copy boundaries

requirements.need: subgroup size known before porting shuffles
requirements.fallback: work-group reduction

requirements.need: a matrix path on the target device
requirements.fallback: scalar or dp4a path; joint_matrix support differs per device

requirements.need: the device image inspected for the intended target
requirements.fallback: an unvalidated device image is unverified

rebar.benefit: Apple silicon uses unified memory; there is no discrete BAR window to enlarge

requirements.need: Metal compiler from the Xcode toolchain
requirements.fallback: there is no portable substitute for the Metal front end

requirements.need: macOS host (Metal is Apple-only)
requirements.fallback: another backend; Metal cannot be emulated

requirements.need: simdgroup width and matrix support known
requirements.fallback: threadgroup reduction

requirements.need: metallib inspected for the intended GPU family
requirements.fallback: an uninspected metallib is unverified
